# List of international presidential trips made by Aleksandar Vučić

Since assuming office in May 2017, Aleksandar Vučić has made numerous international trips in his capacity as the President of Serbia.
Summary
The number of visits per country where President Vučić traveled as of December 19, 2025 are:
* One visit to China, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Hungary, India, Moldova, North Macedonia and the United Kingdom
* Two visits to Albania, Germany, Spain and the United States
* Three visits to Russia
